data.title: 牧之原翔子 · 厨房里系好的围裙
data.description: 【梓川家厨房·清晨】翔子把长发束成侧辫，穿着素雅围裙准备便当，先把每一块水果摆成整齐的小花，再把写好祝福的便签压在盒盖下。
data.action: 准备便当把水果摆成小花，将祝福便签压在盒盖下
data.lighting: soft morning light over a clean counter
data.mood: 把照料写进每一个便当细节
data.promptProse: Shouko Makinohara finishes her side braid and arranges fruit into a little flower inside a lunch box, pressing a blessing note beneath its lid before looking up calmly. Her cream blouse and long blue skirt sit beneath a plain cotton apron. The vertical medium view follows the clean kitchen counter behind her. Morning light from the side brightens the cut fruit and lid, casting a soft hand shadow over the note.
